item.title: LPT’s Within and Without End: A Performance about Performers within Performers
item.description: Langgam Performance Troupe (LPT) opens its 11th year of independent performance-making with Within and Without End (WAWE), a meta-devised work that reflects on the craft of acting and performance.

item.title: Anson's 3‑Day Online Sale: Up to 45% OFF on Appliances
item.description: Looking to upgrade your home without overspending? Anson's makes it easy with a limited‑time online sale that brings big savings on appliances you love. Whether it’s refreshing your kitchen, upgrading laundry essentials, or adding comfort to your living space, you’ll find trusted brands at prices that fit your budget.

item.title: SM Malls & SM Store 3‑Day Sale with up to 70% OFF Mallwide & Storewide
item.description: SM Malls and the SM Store are bringing back their much‑loved 3‑Day Sale, offering up to 70% OFF mallwide, and storewide. Whether you’re planning a surprise gift, upgrading your wardrobe, or indulging in a self‑love shopping spree, this SALE is your chance to shop smarter and save bigger.

item.title: Primer Group Sale for a Cause: Up to 50% OFF
item.description: 🎉 BIG SALE FOR A CAUSE!Looking for great deals that also make a difference? The Primer Group is teaming up with the Tzu Chi Foundation Philippines to bring you a BIG SALE FOR A CAUSE. With discounts of up to 50% OFF on bags, shoes, sandals, luggage, and more lifestyle brands, this event is more than just shopping—it’s about supporting a meaningful mission.

item.title: Greenwich #SarapToFeelG Pizza Party: Free Slice Today & Tomorrow
item.description: 🍕 FREE Slice of Pizza? Yes, Please!👀 Pizza lovers, this is your moment! Greenwich Pizza is throwing a #SarapToFeelG Pizza Party, and everyone’s invited to join the fun.

item.title: Celebrate Sweet Moments: Krispy Kreme Half Dozen Deal this 2026
item.description: 🍩 #SpotYourHappy with Krispy Kreme’s Sweet Deal!Treat yourself and your loved ones to a sweet deal that’s impossible to resist! item.title: SM Home MEGA Warehouse Sale: Huge Discounts on Furniture, Décor & Essentials
item.description: The SM Home MEGA Warehouse Sale is back—and it’s bigger than ever! From February 27 to March 1, head to SM Megamall, Megatrade Halls 1 & 2 for the ultimate home shopping spree! Score unbeatable discounts and exclusive deals on furniture, décor, kitchenware, and more—everything you need to refresh your space in one MEGA event.

item.title: Century Seafood Restaurant 3rd Anniversary Promo: Special Discounts on Signature Dishes
item.description: Century Seafood Restaurant in Malate, Manila is celebrating its 3rd Anniversary with a feast of flavors and unbeatable deals. Indulge in signature dishes — like Xiaolong Pao, Peking Duck, and more — at special anniversary prices! Plus, enjoy 30% OFF dim sum lunch from Monday to Saturday.

item.title: Samgyupsalamat Day 3.3 Promo: Unlimited Pork K‑BBQ for ₱333 Nationwide
item.description: 🥩 Happy Samgyupsalamat Day! 🎉 Yes, March 3 is Samgyupsalamat Day! Every year, fans of Korean BBQ look forward to this nationwide promo and celebration of flavor, fun, and friendship.

item.description: 🍕 Double the XL Fun at Angel’s Pizza! One slice is never enough — so why not grab two? On March 3, 2026 only, Angel’s Pizza is serving up a deal that’s perfect for sharing (or keeping all to yourself).
